chapter: Barnet, 52nd Street and New York recording dates
title: 52nd Street clubs and rooms
summary: Every room had a name act, Erroll Garner, Dizzy Gillespie's group and Eddie Heywood among them.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: There's a drug store downstairs, and we all used to go in there and eat breakfast. They had short order things. But 52nd Street was very interesting because every -- every room there had some kind of name or semi-name. They were just getting started then, you know, a lot of them. I know Errol Garner was down the street. He just hadn't come from Pittsburgh too long before. He was down there.
Of course, Dizzy Gillespie and that little group, he had together was (inaudible) those down there. And Eddie Haywood had a little group right next to where I was, nice little group.
